title: Oven rösti with fried egg and cottage cheese
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes and squeeze out well.
Mix with oil, salt and pepper and spread as two flat rounds on a lined tray.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.
Fry the eggs in a pan.
Serve the rösti with the fried eggs, cottage cheese and chives.
